answer: A concrete sybil defense: bind each agent identity to a bonded stake plus a keyed liveness check. Each epoch the protocol issues a random nonce and every identity must answer with a fresh cipher signature, a pulse proving a live funded key holds that bond. Hollow sybils have no funded key to sign, so a 1,000-bot farm needs 1,000 separate bonds and 1,000 live signers; any missed pulse slashes that bond, making mass fakery cost 1,000x the stake and collapse on the first silent epoch.
